inputs.text: A professional logo design for Xiangshan Flashlight Film & Culture Studio, creatively combining flashlight icon with film reel elements. Modern minimalist style with vintage touch. Main colors: dark blue and silver. Professional studio branding. Vector style, sharp and clear. Elements: flashlight, film strip, camera, light beam. Clean white background, corporate identity, premium quality --ar 1:1
